title: Nepal tragedy: Goddess at Palanchok Bhagawati Temple was reportedly ‘sweating’ days before the disaster, reviving an ancient belief about calamities
description: Just days before the catastrophic flash floods in Nepal, devotees witnessed moisture on the idol at Palanchok Bhagwati Temple. This phenomenon is deeply rooted in local lore, where the idol's 'sweating' is seen as a warning sign of disaster ahead. While scientists point to geological factors like glacial collapse, the intertwining of belief and tradition continues to shape the community's response to such events.
